owner_decision: 2026-10-28, the owner: 'merge PR #16 and do 1, 2, 3, 4, 5' (item 3: more families in parallel); handoff/decisions/2026-10-28c_proof_program.md
question: an AVOID flag: after an 8-K reporting unregistered sales of equity (Item 3.02), does the issuer underperform matched twins over the next 20 sessions? Prior evidence: US_8K_ITEMS (counted test 27, survivor-only, 2020-07..2023): Item 3.02 mean 20-session excess -2.82%, t -4.33, n 1,558. Not a short: borrow costs are not free data, so no short return is claimed.
event: an 8-K (EDGAR form type exactly '8-K'; not 8-K/A) whose EDGAR current-feed entry lists 'Item 3.02' in its summary
source: EDGAR current-filings Atom feed, https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcurrent&type=8-K&company=&dateb=&owner=include&start=<k>&count=100&output=atom (filer entries; <updated> = acceptance time; the summary lists the items); up to 9 pages per batch, stopping at a page older than the window start or the previous batch's newest entry
batches: as SEC13D: every batch is recorded, also an empty one; every new 8-K with Item 3.02 is listed with a status; a batch whose read does not reach back to the previous batch's newest entry (the window start for the first batch), or reads nothing, records a coverage gap; missed filings are never backfilled

issuer.universe: a ticker of the issuer CIK (company_tickers_exchange.json, sha256 recorded per batch), the first in SEC order that is fresh and eligible in the US paper scan of the signal session (else SKIP_NOT_IN_UNIVERSE; no ticker: SKIP_NO_TICKER); an operating issuer by catalysts.is_operating (a 10-K, 10-Q, 20-F or 40-F in 550 days, no fund report; else SKIP_NOT_OPERATING)
issuer.repeat: another 8-K with Item 3.02 from the same issuer in the 90 calendar days before (submissions JSON 'items'), or a set of this family on the same issuer sealed in those days -> SKIP_REPEAT_90D

timing.entry_session: the first NYSE session whose 09:15 New York time is after the sealing time (catalysts.NYSE_HOLIDAYS, 2026-2027)
timing.signal_session: the NYSE session before the entry session; the US paper scan of that session must exist
timing.entry_cutoff: 09:15 New York time of the entry session; a set sealed later is refused
timing.late: accepted at or before 16:00 New York of the NYSE session before the signal session -> SKIP_LATE

plan.exit: the close of the 20th session after entry
plan.costs: the US profile's fees and cost tiers (EXEC-US-v1)

coverage: every sealed set is FIRE (no abstention rule; a replication of test 27's event); the pre-entry move (as SEC13D's MOVED_ALREADY input) is recorded, descriptively
twins: speculation.draw_twins on the signal session's US features (band, liquidity, momentum, drawdown; fresh, eligible, not flagged), excluding the batch's event tickers and the scan's candidates, permuted with seed int(sha256('KOD-CATALYST-REGISTER-v1:' + set_id)[:8], 16); taken in that order, a name is a twin if it is an operating issuer and has no idxsig.catalyst.is_dilution filing (8-K Item 3.02, 424B, S-1, S-3, F-1, F-3, EFFECT) in the 90 days before sealing; at most 15 checked; the first 5 that pass

cone.statement: the plan's net return is below the twins' median net return
cone.prior_source: declared and weak: test 27's mean 20-session excess was -2.82% (t -4.33); its share of negative excess is not on record

cone.statement: the plan's net return after costs is above zero
the plan's net return is at or below -10%
a close in the 20 sessions after the signal session is at least 1.30 x the signal close

decision.sample: sets of this family, window H20, RESOLVED with a paired difference

MEAN.what: per-session mean of (twins' mean net - plan net), one-sided t against 0, df = sessions - 1
MEAN.eligible_extra: none (an avoid flag; the estimate is the underperformance)

WIN_RATE.what: per set, a win is the plan's net below the twins' median net (LOSES_TO_TWINS_20); per-session share of wins, one-sided t against 0.5

looks.source: the same design as research/CATALYST_REGISTER_v1/prereg_2.json (Lan-DeMets O'Brien-Fleming-type spending at 60/120/240 with the t >= 3.0 floor, then t >= 3.0)

at_a_look.eligible: t >= that look's t_min, one-sided p < 0.05, estimate > 0, and the primary's eligible_extra
at_a_look.futility: from the 240 look on, a primary whose estimate is <= 0 stops: FAIL (futility)
at_a_look.fail: a primary not eligible at the 1920 look fails
at_a_look.confirmed: eligible at a look and at the next look
at_a_look.family: the family stops when both primaries have stopped

decision.reading: ELIGIBLE means an exclusion rule worth the owner's review (avoid these names after an Item 3.02 8-K); it never means a short trade

forbidden: a backtest of this family (test 27 is the prior evidence; this register is the prospective test)
changing a rule after the first set of this family is sealed (a change is a v2 with its own trial files)
any order, any short, any change to PAPER-POLICY-v4 or ledger.jsonl
